description: Agent Risk: submit one planned action as the series it runs in: the action with its id, what one run puts at stake, its unit, how many times it runs, the span the runs fall in, the total the plan states for the whole series, whether a fault in one run repeats in every run (such as one wrong address) and its description, read for wording that repeats without an end, such as until it succeeds, keep retrying or indefinitely; each follow-on it sets off with its id, name, what it puts at stake and whether it runs automatically, after an approval or on a condition (an empty list when none); the most the series and its follow-ons may put at stake, with its unit; and optionally the share of that limit that counts as elevated (80 when left out). The signed report gives the action with any unbounded wording, every follow-on with its trigger, the series with the stake per run, the runs, their total, the follow-ons’ total, the series total and its share of the limit, and counts the runs, follow-ons, automatic follow-ons and follow-ons with no stake, and names a runaway series: a series over its limit and a plan that repeats with no stated end; then a series near its limit, runs that fail together, a follow-on that runs by itself, a plan that states a smaller series total than its runs add up to and a plan that sizes only one run, with the fix for each. This reads one action as the series of runs and follow-ons it sets off, past the single-action view: a system’s retry plan is wever_retry-plan-check, where a payment retry can charge twice is wever_retry-safety-check, the effects a resumed or retried task can repeat are wever_duplicate-effect-check and duplicate-looking payments in a transaction list are wever_spending-anomaly-check. Verdict risk_compounding_runaway, risk_compounding_elevated, risk_compounding_untracked or risk_compounding_bounded. POST /api/risk-compounding-check. Reads only the recorded material about the planned action in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, configuration change or external write; the planned action is not taken, paused, approved or undone and no limit, position or dependency is changed. Agent Risk reads the consequences of an action the agent plans to take, before it takes it: how much it puts at stake against the agent’s limits, whether it can be undone, how far a failure would spread beyond its target, the worst credible outcome against what the principal can absorb, whether it piles value into one place, what it depends on staying available or true, whether acting now is itself the risk and whether repeating or chaining it multiplies the risk. It is not confidence in information (the wever_uncertainty checks read how sure the information behind a decision is; a risk check reads what the action costs if it goes wrong: uncertainty is about what the agent knows, risk is about what the action can do), not permission (wever_consent-scope-check reads whether the principal’s grant covers a use and wever_authority-scope-check reads whether the agent may act at all; a risk check reads the consequences of an action already permitted, and a permission never makes an action safe), not an agreement’s exposure (wever_negotiation-risk-check reads the value handed over before a counterparty pays under one proposed agreement; a risk check reads one action the agent is about to take) and not sorting work (the wever_triage checks sort, route and escalate a queue of work; a risk check assesses one planned action before it runs). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-risk-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-risk/.

description.description: The planned action as written, read for wording that repeats without an end, such as until it succeeds.

period.description: The span the runs fall in, such as a day.

stated_total.description: The total the plan states for the whole series.

unit.description: The unit amounts are counted in, such as USDC.

follow_ons.description: The actions this one sets off; empty when none.

id.description: The follow-on id, such as f1.

trigger.description: It runs automatically, after an approval, or on a condition.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

total.description: The most the series and its follow-ons may put at stake.

unit.description: The unit amounts are counted in, such as USDC.

warn_percent.description: A series at or above this share of the limit counts as elevated; 80 when left out.
